hero.headline: Find out what AI should take off your plate, before you buy anything
hero.subheadline: A few questions about how your business runs today: where the work piles up, what you have already tried, and how soon it needs fixing. Conaugh reads every one personally, and you can book a short call as soon as you leave your details. Free AI audit. No pitch.

vsl_script.text:
AI AUTOMATION AUDIT VSL. Target 2 to 3 minutes. Conaugh on camera, eye level, quiet room, natural light from one side (the window-light look). Captions burned in. End on the OASIS end card.
Rule for the whole video: no number, result, client name or testimonial that is not confirmed. Where real proof belongs, the script says [CC: proof here]; leave it out if there is none yet.

[BEAT 1. HOOK, 0:00 to 0:15]
On camera: If every question in your business comes back to you, this is for you.

[BEAT 2. THE WEEK, 0:15 to 0:45]
On camera: The answers live in your head, your inbox and a dozen open tabs. Leads come in while you are doing the work. The same admin shows up every week: re-typing details, chasing invoices, sending the same reminders.

[BEAT 3. WHY IT STAYS THAT WAY, 0:45 to 1:15]
On camera: Everyone says AI will fix it. So you buy a tool, and it does not know how your business actually runs. The problem was never the tool. Nobody looked at the work first.

[BEAT 4. WHAT THE AUDIT IS, 1:15 to 1:50]
On camera: That is what this audit is for. You answer a few questions about how the business runs today: where the work piles up, what you have tried, and how soon you need it fixed. Revenue and budget are optional.
On camera: I read every one personally, and I follow up with you. You get a straight answer on where AI would take real work off your plate, where it would only add cost or risk, and where a simpler fix is enough.
[CC: proof here, only if a client has given permission to be named]

[BEAT 5. WHAT IT IS NOT, 1:50 to 2:10]
On camera: It is free, and it is not a sales call in disguise. Nothing is sold to you on the form. If OASIS is a fit, I will tell you what building it would involve. If it is not, I will tell you that too.

[BEAT 6. CALL TO ACTION, 2:10 to 2:30]
On camera: Start your free audit below. If you are not ready, the free OASIS community is linked on this page. Come back when the timing is right.

sections.title: The whole week runs through you

items.title: Every question comes back to you
items.body: The answers live in your head, your inbox and a dozen open tabs, so the team waits on you.

items.title: Leads wait while you are busy
items.body: Enquiries arrive while you are doing the work, and follow-up happens whenever you remember.

items.title: The same admin, every week
items.body: Re-typing details between systems, chasing invoices, sending the same reminders by hand.

items.title: Tools you bought and stopped using
items.body: Each one promised to fix it. None of them knew how your business actually runs.

items.title: No idea where AI actually fits
items.body: Everyone says AI will help. Nobody has told you which part of your week it should touch first.

sections.title: A real read on your operation, by a real person

items.title: Read by Conaugh, personally
items.body: Your answers go to Conaugh McKenna, the founder of OASIS, not into an automated sequence. Conaugh reads every one personally.

items.title: A straight answer on where AI fits
items.body: On the call you hear where AI would take real work off your plate, where it would only add cost or risk, and where a simpler fix is enough.

items.title: The right next step, including the free ones
items.body: If OASIS is a fit, you hear what building it would involve. If it is not, you hear that too, and where to go instead, like the free OASIS community.

sections.title: Three steps, and you stay in control

items.title: Leave your details, pick a time
items.body: Your name and how to reach you, then the calendar opens right here.

items.title: Answer the questions that help
items.body: Where the bottleneck is, the rough size of the business and when you need it working. Revenue and budget are optional. Conaugh reads every one personally.

items.title: Get a straight answer, then decide
items.body: On the call you hear where AI fits, where it would only add cost or risk, and where a simpler fix is enough. The next step is your choice.

items.a: Yes. The audit costs nothing and nothing is sold to you on the form. If you later want OASIS to build something, that is a separate conversation, and only if you want it.
Conaugh McKenna, the founder of OASIS. He reads every one personally.

items.q: Do I need to know anything about AI?
items.a: No. Describe how the work moves today in plain words. Working out where AI fits is the point of the audit.

items.q: Do I have to share revenue or budget?
items.a: No. Those questions are optional ranges, and skipping them does not rule you out.
Conaugh reads every one personally. As soon as you leave your details, a calendar opens on this page so you can book a short call, and the Google Meet invite goes to your email.
It is a video call on Google Meet. You walk through how the week runs today, and you hear where AI fits, where it would only add cost or risk, and where a simpler fix is enough. No pitch.
Short. The calendar shows the exact length when you pick a time.

items.q: Do I need to prepare anything?
items.a: No. Your answers are enough. Bring the part of the week that frustrates you most.

items.q: What does it cost if I want OASIS to build something?
items.a: That depends on what the audit finds, and it is a separate decision you make later. Every path lists its prices on its own page: start at oasisai.work/vsl.

items.q: Is this for my size of business?
items.a: It suits owner-led businesses and growing teams where the week runs through a few people. Larger and multi-location operations should look at FLEET, which starts with an enterprise AI and security audit.
That is fine. Join the free OASIS community on Telegram, build alongside other owners, and come back when the timing is right. Join here: https://oasisai.work/go/community?form=ai-audit&t=oasis-ai-cc
